breakpoints.note: `H5FD_locate_signature()` checks address 0 first (`addr = 0` when `n == 8`) before trying higher power-of-two offsets, so this is the format-admission checkpoint that fixes all downstream parsed-file offsets. Raw-input offsets are therefore one byte larger than the parsed-file offsets cited below.
The libFuzzer entry point is only the unscored harness boundary. The vulnerability-relevant parser state begins here, inside HDF5's superblock reader.

On the exact written-file witness these four bytes are `01 1a ff ff`, so `status_flags == 0xffff1a01` but `sblock->status_flags` becomes `0x01`. The fix replaces the assertion-only invariant with `if (status_flags > 255) HGOTO_ERROR(...)` at this exact site.
